title: luzula campestris
intro: Luzula campestris, commonly known as Field Woodrush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. It is a perennial herb native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, known for its sword-shaped leaves and small white or pinkish flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Luzula campestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
